note: Bare '* WAIT' heading: same as bare '* TODO' (org-element needs trailing text; org-entry-get and agenda treat it as a TODO state)
Lowercase 'scheduled:' is not planning in orgfdb (fixture pins it); Org 9.6 parses it as a planning line and, through a case-fold quirk, files the timestamp under :closed
file+sys:/file+emacs: keep the full scheme as link_type; Org splits :type file plus :application (query-language.org resolver section)
Bracket link with an unregistered scheme is typed by orgfdb; Org treats unregistered schemes as fuzzy (links.custom_protocols in config.org)
Links inside property drawer values are stored with source_context property_drawer (schema.sql); Org does not parse objects in property values
Tag block with empty pieces (::a::) stays in the title; orgfdb requires every tag non-empty (parser-risks.org, Title normalization); org-element yields empty tags
Numeric priority [#10] is stored as priority (schema.sql); org-element only reads a single character cookie
Bare '* TODO' is a TODO state in orgfdb and in Org's outline/agenda regexps (org-entry-get); org-element requires trailing text
